cross_prover_agreement_mechanisms.what_is_established: Syntactic and structural alignment at the specification DSL level across emitted Coq/Rocq, HOL4, Isabelle/HOL, and Lean 4 backends
cross_prover_agreement_mechanisms.residual_trust_gap: Each backend code generator (`sail -coq` vs. `sail -lean`), monad library (`PreSailM`), and primitive bitvector mapping remains unverified unless paired with a target-level bijection/simulation proof

cross_prover_agreement_mechanisms.what_is_established: Target kernel re-verifies the translated proof steps in a single unified logic (e.g. Dedukti, Rocq, or HOL4/Candle)
cross_prover_agreement_mechanisms.residual_trust_gap: Requires extensionality axioms (`pIrrel`, `Singleton.elim`, `quot_sound`), stubs 43 reflection lemmas in `lean2dk`, or disables positivity/guard checks in `rocq-lean-import`; still requires `leanprover/comparator` statement verification on the boundary definitions

cross_prover_agreement_mechanisms.what_is_established: Empirical falsification of shallow decoding/semantic bugs across finite test corpora
cross_prover_agreement_mechanisms.residual_trust_gap: Cannot establish universal semantic equivalence across unbounded inputs or unexercised instruction/flag corners (`canary_unverified_prover_translation_mismatch`)
